profileLabel: Center-left economics; restrictive-leaning on speech and security bills (low confidence)
summary: Palawan 3rd District representative whose authored bills center on state-backed farmer and health insurance, with co-authorship of a national minimum wage. Co-authored disinformation and espionage measures lean restrictive, but those are multi-sponsor bills.
caveat: Mostly co-authored bills; no social-values or institutions score possible from reviewed evidence. Bill-list extraction was automated and spot-checked, not read in full.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Principal author of national crop insurance for small farmers and NHIP mental-health coverage (state-led social insurance); co-author of national minimum wage. Host-province revenue-sharing and tax amnesty/travel-tax bills net to mixed on taxation. Bills only; no votes reviewed.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB04626, HB04627, HB05571, HB08081, HB08464 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: No relevant divorce, reproductive, LGBTQ+, gender or religion bills found among reviewed authored bills.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: no relevant bills found (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Restrictive-leaning
civil.rationale: Co-authored disinformation-penalty bill (HB09465) and espionage-law expansion (HB09642); a related bill (HB04544) includes speech-protection language. Multi-sponsor bills only; co-authors may not endorse every provision.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB09465, HB09642, HB04544 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Insufficient evidence
democratic.rationale: Only transparency evidence found (bank-secrecy bill HB06707, co-author); insufficient for a score.
